item.title: Zugerujk.net v1.3.5
item.description: Big news! There's now a page for Island Off Outer Dancing as well as an IOOD Press Kit. To accommodate this, the Outer Darkness tab on the navbar now links to an Island Off Outer Duology landing page, where you can get to sub-pages (and to be clear, I felt very clever when I realized I could call the two games that). No blog posts in this one, as I've been extremely busy working on IOODancing. Go wishlist Island Off Outer Dancing! It'll be free but the engagement still helps.
